about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Rick Scott

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: I proposed term limits for Congress, the end of automatic pay raises for Members, and a bill to ban Members from lobbying after serving in Congress.
Now, some people might think a 2-year cooling-off period is enough, but many Floridians disagree.
When former Members of Congress go from public office to a lobbying job, instead of representing their constituents, many Floridians believe the swamp wins and the American people lose.

Notwithstanding rule XXII, I ask unanimous consent that the Committee on the Judiciary be discharged from further consideration of S. 4524 and the Senate proceed to its immediate consideration; further, that the bill be considered read a third time and passed and that the motion to reconsider be considered made and laid upon the table.

So, unfortunately, my colleague is leaving, but I look forward to trying to work with my colleague and others to try to have a bill that, you know, stops this revolving door of people coming to the Senate, coming to the Congress, and then immediately leave and become lobbyists.
And today I am here to pass my Banning Lobbying And Safeguarding Trust, or BLAST, Act, a bipartisan bill I cosponsored with Senator Elizabeth Warren.
By the way, I will be glad to take any amendment ideas anybody has.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STRENGTHENING AMERICA'S TURNING POINT ACT
statements.title: STRENGTHENING AMERICA'S TURNING POINT ACT
sentences: Thanks to government--your government--it is now too often a 4-year runway to a lifetime of debt.
Average student debt is just under $40,000, according to the Education Data Initiative.
Fifty years ago, the median age of a first-time home buyer was 29 years old; today, it is 40.
Now, thanks to government interference, especially ObamaCare, costs continue to go up and options are getting more and more limited for the average family.
We are now $40 trillion in debt.
To those who want to claim it is all defense spending, that is not true.
We spent about 3 percent of our GDP on defense spending last fiscal year.
But we spend about $3 billion per day on interest payments on our debt while we run $2 trillion deficits for programs that clearly aren't working--$2 trillion each year.
If you confiscated every asset from every billionaire in the United States, you would only be able to run the Federal Government for just over a year.
Democrats say: Oh, just tax the rich.
So we will take all the money from the billionaires, you can barely fund the government for a year.
Who do you think they are going to come for when they bleed the millionaires and billionaires?
Instead of holding government accountable, politicians in Washington have armed a $40 trillion debt bomb by massively expanding the Federal Government year after year.
While promising lower prices, Congress keeps approving massive government spending bills, causing prices and interest rates to skyrocket for the same voters we promised to lower prices for.
Wages are rising, but inflation--inflation caused by government spending approved by Congress--is cutting into what those wage gains can do for families.

We have to dramatically reduce government spending to balance the Federal budget, shred the massive regulatory regime that has grown out of control in Washington, and third, we have to make job creation the No. 1 priority through tax cuts, smart investment, and good economic policy.
We need to be willing to stay here to debate with each other about how we reduce our government spending and how we prioritize spending.
These deficits are fueling a $40 trillion debt that costs more than $1 trillion in interest annually.
It is not going to build a better military, Social Security, roads, Medicare.
To save the programs Americans depend on, we must reduce government spending in all the places it doesn't provide a real return for taxpayers and finally balance the Federal budget.
I cut taxes and fees a hundred times, and we still balanced the budget and paid down debt.
I told them that we are not going to spend more than we take in.

From there, we will map the way back to the kind of country that made it possible for a poor kid like me who grew up in public housing, born to a single mom, to become a CEO, a Governor, and a Senator.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECT COLLEGE SPORTS ACT OF 2026
statements.title: PROTECT COLLEGE SPORTS ACT OF 2026
sentences: So here is my problem: I don't think it is appropriate for a resolution that comes to the Senate and basically, essentially, tries to tell those victims that all of those failures--failure after failure--can be covered up with the vague excuse of climate change.
The correct response is not to spend more money when we already are $43 trillion in debt.
We can't write it off as climate change.
We are not going to let the California officials responsible for these wildfires say climate change caused this as an excuse.
Senator Johnson and I are going to keep asking those questions.
Let me be clear, we are not going to give up.
We are not going to let bureaucratic delays prevent us from getting the answers for these families.
We are going to keep requesting the documents.
We are going to keep asking the questions.
We are going to keep following the facts, wherever they lead.
Senator Johnson and I will continue our investigation because the victims deserve nothing less.
So we are going to keep fighting for the truth.
We are going to keep demanding records.
We are going to keep demanding accountability.
We are not going to give up until we get all the answers.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: When I first came to the floor in July to advocate for this bill, my Democrat colleague called the issue of surrogate birth tourism a conspiracy theory.
In July, I came to the floor to warn about Chinese birth tourism based on a story in my home State of Florida.

CBS: `` `Who do we hand the baby to?' Loopholes and shady practices taint U.S. surrogacy industry.'' The Wall Street Journal: ``The Chinese Billionaires Having Dozens of U.S.-Born Babies Via Surrogate.'' Fortune: ``Chinese billionaire who has fathered more than 100 children''--you can't make this stuff up--``hopes to have dozens of U.S.-born boys to one day take over his business.'' The Wall Street Journal: ``A Florida Surrogate, a Father in China, and the Babies Caught in Between.'' New York Magazine: ``Whose babies are these?

A Chinese man hired a Florida surrogate, then didn't pick up his kids, sparking a custody battle that could upend the industry.'' So the Wall Street Journal, New York Magazine, and CBS News have all run major stories about birth tourism since I last brought this to the floor.

Anyone overseas, including citizens of enemy countries--these are the types of people that could have surrogates--can get American birthright citizenship for a child by contracting a surrogate in America.
The threat is obvious: foreign adversaries having a backdoor to every privilege of being an American while spending no time--no time; they don't even have to show up in this country.
Chinese billionaire Xu Bo, a member of the CCP, has allegedly fathered between 100 and 300 American children via surrogacy, with birthright citizenship.
First, it will invalidate commercial surrogacy contracts involving designated foreign adversaries--communist China, Iran, Russia, North Korea.

I hope that my colleagues have seen the reports and the problem with birth tourism since we last discussed it, and I hope all of my colleagues see the solution here: passing a very narrow bill, the SAFE KIDS Act.
Notwithstanding rule XXII, I ask unanimous consent that the Committee on the Judiciary be discharged from further consideration of S. 3101 and the Senate proceed to its immediate consideration.
That is why I am going to continue working with my colleagues to support the SAFE KIDS Act.
If I have to keep coming down here and keep doing unanimous consents after we continue to see story after story, I am going to keep doing it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Imagine if every State in the Union, on a whim, had the power to allow foreign nationals to travel to their States without a visa.
It is in this small U.S. Pacific island territory where foreign nationals can legally enter America without having a visa.

Since 2009, the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, or CNMI, has become a hotbed for birth tourism, which is a strategy used by citizens of foreign powers to deliberately undermine our Nation's immigration laws.
They have passports, birth certificates, and Social Security cards.
The CCP and Chinese civilians found this loophole and have exploited it for birthright citizenship.

You can be a full-fledged devotee of the CCP-- you can actually hate America and hate our people and hate our way of life--and still abuse birth tourism to get a foothold in the country you seek to undermine and destroy.
I am grateful to Secretary Mullin, who, while a U.S. Senator, signed on to my letter to then-Secretary Noem that called for an end to China's participation in any Chinese visa waiver program.
We don't want to do anything that absolutely hurts the economy of the CNMI, but at the same time, we have got to figure this out to make sure that we don't have birth tourism.
So I look forward to working with my colleague in a constructive manner to make sure that, you know, the Communist Party of China does not abuse this so as to have birth tourism there.

statements.title: CONDEMNING THE DICTATOR OF THE PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC OF CHINA, XI JINPING, FOR DECEIT, UNDERMINING PROSPECTS FOR PEACE AND SECURITY, AND ORCHESTRATING CRIMES AGAINST HUMANITY

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Department of Homeland Security (Executive Session)
statements.title: Department of Homeland Security (Executive Session)
sentences: Here, the junior Senator from Vermont is admitting that this shutdown, which Democrats caused by claiming that they needed to defund ICE to force bipartisan reforms, isn't actually impacting ICE agents at all.
Now, the folks at ICE that don't only work in law enforcement are being hurt.
Now, there are a lot of people at ICE that are not law enforcement.
TSA agents, most of the people at DHS, everyone at ICE who isn't law enforcement, they are going hungry.
We know that, under Biden, the border was completely wide open and criminals just flocked into this country and not one of my Democratic colleagues said a word.
They never want to talk about Laken Riley, Rachel Morin, Jocelyn Nungaray--murdered by illegal aliens.
Now, he ended his point by saying this: It's ripe for us to have a sensible discussion about a reasonable immigration plan, in a reasonable way to deal with folks who don't have legal status.
My friend, the junior Senator from Vermont, is talking about amnesty.

He is talking about using a government shutdown, using the paychecks of TSA workers, using 3- or 4-hour security lines, using the pain felt by disabled Americans like Ambria Britt who had to pay a stranger to push her wheelchair through security as leverage--as leverage--to open a conversation about amnesty to people who are in this country illegally.
I actually agree with making sure badges are visible for uniformed law enforcement officers.
They encourage their fellow activists to hunt our law enforcement and give them all the tools to do so.
They are doing what police do, what sheriffs do: They are working every day to enforce the laws of this country that we pass, but many of my Democratic colleagues want to see them as monsters.
But if wearing a mask keeps a law enforcement officer and their family safe from being attacked by radical anti-ICE activists, I am all for it.
Now, I support measures that keep our police accountable to the people they serve and protect.
We started bringing body cameras in when I was Governor of Florida.
The White House has proposed body cameras, and I completely agree with that proposal.
When I just flew through the Denver airport, I saw a couple of the law enforcement officers.
Now, I think my Democratic colleagues ought to have skin in the game.
So I am not going to ask for a UC, but I wish at some point we would pass my No Budget, No Pay Act so we all have skin in the game.
So I urge my colleagues to consider this: What about the mortgages of DHS workers?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Department of Homeland Security (Executive Session)
statements.title: Department of Homeland Security (Executive Session)
sentences: A union official who represents workers at TSA said: A lot of employees that I've talked to don't have any money in their bank account.

Airports across the country are asking for gift card donations so the people who keep our economy going, the people who make it safe and possible for other Americans to visit their families, do business, or go on vacation can keep scraping by while Democrat politicians in this Chamber can put on a show for the news cameras and fight for illegal aliens.
I don't get it, but Democrats want to defund the police and shut down ICE and CBP.

Once these staffers seized the levers of power without President Biden even realizing it, they opened our southern border and actually allowed or encouraged millions upon millions of illegal aliens to flood into the United States.
They let drugs pour over the border and poison the American people.
They elected President Trump to take the White House and Republicans to take control of Congress because the American people knew we would clean up Biden's mess and secure the border.
President Trump ran on securing the border and getting criminal illegal aliens out of our country.
He is undoing all of their work to let illegal aliens flood across the border, and he is doing it without passing any new laws.
Now, because radical Democrat mayors and Governors won't work with ICE and in some cases are actively encouraging resistance against our Federal law enforcement, there has been conflict.
If we didn't have illegal sanctuary cities in the States, ICE would be able to peacefully detain individuals at jails.
But there are liberal mayors and Governors who want to put the concerns of illegal aliens over American citizens and American law enforcement.
There are violent illegal aliens in our country.
If you don't believe me, here are three names: Rachel Morin, Jocelyn Nungaray, Laken Riley.
Rachel Morin, Jocelyn Nungaray, Laken Riley--a mother and a child and a college student--all murdered.
If ICE can save one person, if ICE can prevent another woman from facing the same fate as Rachel Morin, Jocelyn Nungaray, and Laken Riley, it is worth it.

I don't get it, but Democrats insist on protecting illegal aliens with sanctuary policies while they spit in the faces of American law enforcement officers who risk their lives every day, every single day, to keep us safe.
She was stabbed to death while standing at a bus stop in Fairfax County, VA.
On a Monday morning, a mother was ripped from her children by an illegal alien that officials in Virginia refused--they refused--to let ICE deport.

The Center for Immigration Studies found that from October 2022 through February 2025, the Fairfax County Adult Detention Center freed more than 1,000 deportable individuals in direct defiance of over 1,150 ICE detainers.

Fairfax County ranked third in the entire Nation for refusing to honor ICE detainer requests, and soon, all of Virginia could follow suit, because the same week that Stephanie Minter was murdered at that bus stop, new Governor Spanberger ordered the termination of all 287(g) agreements between State agencies and ICE.
According to DHS, sanctuary jurisdictions across the country declined to honor 17,864 ICE detainer requests in 2025 alone--nearly 18,000 in 1 year.
In California alone, over 4,500 criminal individuals have been released since January 2025 despite active ICE detainers.
In New York, ICE has documented cases where individuals with records including rape, strangulation, and burglary were repeatedly released by sanctuary policies.
First, Democrats pass sanctuary laws to protect violent illegals that they know their Soros-funded prosecutors won't go after.

Now Democrats are trying to destroy ICE completely so that the very system of brave law enforcement officers, which was established to save the lives of individuals like Stephanie, Laken, Rachel, and Jocelyn, could no longer protect our families.
I don't know why the Democrats want to defund our law enforcement.
The thing I struggle with most is, I don't know why the left is so hell-bent on protecting illegal aliens while letting a mother like Stephanie Minter be stabbed to death at a bus stop.

Now these people who are working full time, dealing with long lines, very frustrated travelers, and long brutal days, dead on their feet, many probably working overtime to protect us, are going home to empty refrigerators, overdue bills, and eviction notices because of my Democrat colleagues' political theater for illegal aliens.

That is just another way of saying they want to defund the police so they can hamstring our ability to enforce immigration laws--again, not for the benefit of American citizens but for the benefit of illegal aliens.
America is better than this, and I am not going to stop fighting until these radical attempts end to put illegal aliens before American citizens.
It is a problem the Democrats caused because the border was completely open for 4 years.
With regard to masks, law enforcement does use masks because they have to protect their privacy sometimes.
Sure, I think we ought to always have reasonable restrictions on how law enforcement works.
But ICE is busting their butt to solve a problem that was caused by having 4 years of completely open borders, and nobody on the Democrat side wanted to talk about it.
And we can't allow more heartbreaking stories like Alondra, Susan, Rachel, Jocelyn, Laken, and Stephanie.

statements.title: SAFEGUARD AMERICAN VOTER ELIGIBILITY ACT

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: I rise today to fight for working families and businesses.
The DC City Council has decided to deny the people of DC the benefits we passed in President Trump's Working Families Tax Cuts Act.
It helps the thousands of service workers here in DC, the law enforcement that protects us every day, and the grandparents who are watching their grandkids while their children are at work.
When I was Governor of Florida, I cut taxes over 100 times through tax cuts just like the ones in the Working Families Tax Cuts Act.
We paid down a third of the State's debt and actually invested a record amount back into communities and public services.
I urge my colleagues to do our constitutional duty to the people of DC and support this resolution. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DISAPPROVING THE ACTION OF THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA COUNCIL IN APPROVING THE D.C. INCOME AND FRANCHISE TAX CONFORMITY AND REVISION TEMPORARY AMENDMENT ACT OF 2025
statements.title: DISAPPROVING THE ACTION OF THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA COUNCIL IN APPROVING THE D.C. INCOME AND FRANCHISE TAX CONFORMITY AND REVISION TEMPORARY AMENDMENT ACT OF 2025
sentences: We don't need to nationalize our elections.
My Republican colleagues and I have been fighting Democrats' attempts to nationalize our elections for years now.
There should be some commonsense, national standards in place to ensure Americans know their elections are free and fair and that their votes are not diluted.
That includes requiring voter ID, something 83 percent of Americans support.
Surely, we can also agree that requiring proof of citizenship makes sense.
And if a State has a noncitizen on the voter rolls, they should be removed.
The SAVE America Act puts these commonsense ideas into place to make our elections more secure and fair.
I invite my colleagues to support my UC and pass the SAVE America Act.
President Trump and the American people are all on board with the SAVE America Act.
Passing the SAVE America Act is an essential step to our democracy, ensuring free and fair elections nationwide.
I can't understand why he wouldn't support some commonsense standard like this, but I am going to keep working, and we are going to get this passed.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONSOLIDATED APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: CONSOLIDATED APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Mr. President, I would like to thank my colleague Senator Lee for working with me to stop Democrats' wasteful spending in this package and bring accountability for the American people.
Our Nation is nearly $39 trillion in debt, running $2 trillion deficits, and spending billions of dollars--up to 10 percent of our Federal spending--on fraud and abuse.
Why should the American taxpayer foot the bill to support illegals in sanctuary cities when so many American citizens are struggling themselves?
I ask my colleagues to support my amendment to stop wasteful spending and wasteful earmarks.
We will never get inflation under control and interest rates down until we balance the Federal budget.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: I mean, I don't care whether, you know, it is the military or the FAA or people that work here on the Senate floor, the people who work in our offices, Capitol Police, everybody should get paid.

Republicans have voted to open the government, and Democrats have voted to shut down the government and not pay food stamps, our troops, our air traffic controllers, or Capitol Police, the people that take care of us.

They don't care about members of our military who are trying to provide for their families while protecting country; they don't care about moms who rely on SNAP to feed their kids this month; they don't care about the Capitol Police who are keeping them safe every single day; they don't care about the millions of Americans who planned to fly that are now losing money on canceled tickets, unsure of their safety in the skies, and have to scramble to see and spend or decide: Should I go home at Thanksgiving?
Millions of struggling Americans who don't know when they will be able to feed their families or know how they are going to pay the mortgage or pay rent--Capitol Police--and think about it.
The Capitol Police, Democrats see them each and every day.
And they can look them in the eye and say they voted to make sure the Capitol Police didn't get paid.
Democrats want you, as a taxpayer, to pay for abortion.
President Trump said it this morning; that he wants to address the problems of ObamaCare.
What happened with ObamaCare is they said--let's think of the lies here: You didn't lose your doctor, biggest lie of the year; you are going to save $2,500 a family, it skyrocketed.
You know, back when ObamaCare started, if you had a $3,000 deductible, that was a catastrophic plan.
Now you can have a $10,000, $5,000, $14,000 deductible under ObamaCare.
Well, President Trump said this morning, he wants to address the problems of ObamaCare and stop sending massive checks to insurance companies and give the money directly to Americans.

He said: I am recommending to Senate Republicans that the Hundreds of Billions of Dollars currently being sent to money sucking Insurance Companies in order to save the bad Healthcare provided by ObamaCare BE SENT DIRECTLY TO THE PEOPLE SO THAT THEY CAN PURCHASE THEIR OWN MUCH BETTER HEALTHCARE.
If we want to solve--if we want to fix ObamaCare, we have got to give the money directly to the person.
So if you are going to get a healthcare subsidy under ObamaCare, you should get the money yourself in an HSA and then let you buy what you want.
So what he said: In other words, take from the BIG, BAD INSURANCE COMPANIES, give it to the people, and terminate, per dollar spent, the worst Healthcare [system] anywhere in the World, ObamaCare.
They did it to mask the cost of ObamaCare.
ObamaCare costs are skyrocketing, and they said: Gosh, we don't want people to know that so we are going to give you a whole bunch of money so you won't even know what it costs.
It is all caused by ObamaCare.
You might be going to a wedding.
Now, we should have a conversation about how we fix ObamaCare.
Republicans didn't create ObamaCare.
Last Sunday, when I was home, at the church, we support a food bank, and so the church said: One, will you bring in more food?

statements.title: Order of Business (Executive Calendar)
sentences: Mr. President, I ask unanimous consent that, notwithstanding rule XXII, all postcloture time be expired and the Senate vote on the confirmation of the LaCour nomination at a time to be determined by the majority leader, in consultation with the Democratic leader, no earlier than Wednesday, October 29; further, that if confirmed, the motion to reconsider be considered made and laid upon the table and the President be immediately notified of the Senate's action.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Mr. President, I rise today to talk about my Sunshine Protection Act--a bipartisan, bicameral bill that returns power to each State and its citizens and that will end the twice-yearly time change and make daylight saving time the national, year-round standard.

I ask unanimous consent that the Senate proceed to the immediate consideration of the Sunshine Protection Act, which is at the desk; further, that the bill be considered read a third time and passed and that the motion to reconsider be considered made and laid upon the table.
Our Sunshine Protection Act is a bipartisan, bicameral bill that will allow States to end the twice-yearly time change and make daylight saving time the national, year-round standard.

Nearly two dozen other States have joined Florida in choosing to lock the clock, pending the Federal approval that will come by passing the Sunshine Protection Act, while still allowing other States to opt out if they wish.
In Florida, that is permanent daylight saving time.
We also have self-driving cars, computers, and cell phones.

I ask my colleagues to support the passage of the Sunshine Protection Act to make a commonsense change that will simply benefit the lives of Americans and allow people of each State to choose what is best for themselves and their families.

sentences: Under President Trump and Pete's strong leadership, the U.S. military will once again become the world's most lethal fighting force that our enemies fear and our allies respect, and I will do everything I can to support their mission.
